title: CD sales are making an unexpected comeback amid a retro tech boom
summary: U.S. CD revenue jumped 58.6% in the first half of 2026, reversing last year’s decline as interest in retro tech and physical media continues to grow.
llm_summary: U.S. CD sales have surged, with revenue climbing 58.6% in the first half of 2026—enough to reverse the decline seen the previous year. The rebound is being driven by a broader retro‑tech craze, as collectors and music fans rediscover the tactile appeal of physical media. This unexpected upswing shows that, even in the streaming era, tangible formats can still find a niche market.
